title: Redis
description: An in-memory data store used as a cache, message broker, and session store.

data.text: Redis is an open-source, in-memory data store used as a cache, message broker, and streaming engine. It supports strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, and more.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install the Redis package from NuGet.

data.title: Configuring Redis Cache

terms.definition: An in-memory data store for caching, messaging, and streaming.
An abstraction for distributed caching in ASP.NET Core.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Redis is ideal for caching frequently accessed data and storing user sessions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Redis is a fast in-memory cache
data.takeaway: Redis dramatically improves application performance by caching hot data.

data.description: Set up Redis caching in an ASP.NET Core app.
